description: Complete Raindrop.io control plus offline search, safe cleanup, and durable knowledge workflows.

novel_features.name: Offline Library
novel_features.description: Mirror bookmarks, collections, tags and highlights for instant offline search.

novel_features.name: Inbox Review
novel_features.description: Process Unsorted bookmarks in resumable, bounded review sessions.

novel_features.name: Change History
novel_features.description: Show field-level bookmark changes between sync snapshots.

novel_features.name: Tag Health
novel_features.description: Discover case variants, near-duplicates, singleton tags and merge candidates.

novel_features.name: Duplicate Plans
novel_features.description: Choose canonical bookmarks while preserving tags, notes and highlights.

novel_features.name: Revisit Queue
novel_features.description: Resurface useful forgotten bookmarks without repeating recent suggestions.

novel_features.name: Related Bookmarks
novel_features.description: Find explainable related bookmarks offline using text, tags and domains.

novel_features.name: Highlight Digests
novel_features.description: Create deduplicated Markdown or JSONL study digests from highlights.

novel_features.name: Durable Triage
novel_features.description: Run crash-safe bounded triage queues with retry and manual-review states.
